methodology.net_long: Managed Money long minus short; spreading positions excluded from net.
methodology.net_long_pct_oi: 100 * net long / total COMEX gold futures open interest.
methodology.percentile_156_reports: Percentage of the most recent 156 reports, including current, with net/OI <= current net/OI. Null before 156 reports.
methodology.changes: Difference from prior report only when report dates are seven days apart; no interpolation.
methodology.release: Report dates are position dates, usually Tuesday. Usually published Friday 15:30 US Eastern; holidays and delays can change release.
